text: Verified the app and created REVIEW.md with a **BLOCK** verdict. The app fails on fundamentals: the UI is just a static "Inventory" text label—none of the three MVP features (view, add, remove items) are implemented. Required documentation is missing (ux-walkthrough.md, design-direction.md, ARCHITECTURE.md), and the frontend report appears to be planted evidence with a stale runId instead of a fresh verification.
